packageRules.description: Do not let the pip_requirements manager line-edit DERIVED uv-export requirements.txt files. These are `uv export`/`uv pip compile` artifacts of pyproject.toml + uv.lock; a single-line bump does not re-resolve and produces no-op / self-contradictory PRs (defect #1757 -> fix #1804). uv.lock/pyproject.toml stay managed via the pep621/uv manager; hand-maintained requirements.txt files (no uv provenance) remain managed by pip_requirements. See docs/repo-management/uv-lockfile-conventions.md.

Charmbracelet v2 moved to new charm.land/* import paths with breaking TUI API changes (see closed PRs #2104, #2111, #2112). Renovate only edits one go.mod line, which breaks go mod tidy/build. Migrate bubbles/bubbletea/lipgloss together by hand instead.
Keep Python runtime and requires-python pinned to 3.14.x so Renovate does not treat 3.14 -> 3.15 as a minor bump inside group:allNonMajor.
